name: Harris County, GA
findings: Harris County has 95 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Harris County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Harris County list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Harris County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 11 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
